contract_gaps.detail: 素材库 image rows show 「种子 <n>」 as plain text. BR-7 forbids 种子 in 界面主流程; design D-50 scopes the rule to the image page and never says whether the 素材库 is 主流程; BR-1 says 只改图片页; the visual criteria's global rule applies to every screenshot. Hiding the seed in the library (or exempting it) is a user-visible decision the design does not make, so it is not implemented here.
options: (a) the 素材库 is outside the 主流程: record an exemption in the design (D-50) and the criteria (global rule + library-after-delete.must_not_show)
(b) the 素材库 hides 种子 behind a disclosure like 高级参数: extend D-50 to the library and let image-session-repair implement it

The early truncation comes from the shared .session card layout that reserves the hover-only rename/delete column (F7) and is the same on the chat page; D-70 requires the image list to reuse that style. Changing it for the image list alone breaks D-70's parity; changing it for both touches the chat page. Left for a design decision; minor.

The header's 媒体 status is the shared statusbar updated by main.js's 2 s tick for every media pane; a capture taken within one tick of starting shows 空闲. The real-app run showed 生成中. Changing the global tick is outside the image page (BR-1); minor.
Design D-64 specifies that switching sessions keeps the prompt, width, height and steps (only the seed and chip are cleared); changing it would alter design-set behavior, so no change.
The green 可开工 is the global heavy-work availability in the shared header, not the image model state (the image page's own header and hint name the missing model). Not image-page scope; minor.
